summary: Retained for retrospective model-development research and agent evaluation with the labeled eval split as development/validation data. Each row is one single-country UN-coordinated appeal-year with a positive launch-vintage original requirements figure; every feature is the appeal's own launch-record attribute, except years_since_country_prior, which reads only WHICH strictly-earlier same-country appeals exist (their years, never any outcome), is derivable from the shipped row set itself, and is asserted label-free by brute-force recompute at construction. The prediction instant is the appeal's public launch (event_time, requirements announcement), months before the plan year closes; the label (year-end funding >= 50% of original requirements) is resolved from the FTS flow endpoint's per-plan-year fundingTotal, which never ships. The 2026.10-era prior-outcome features that allowed exact cross-row label recovery (the 2026-11-01 queue audit recovered 120/139 eval and 128/182 holdout labels through count x rounded-rate arithmetic plus the last-prior tie rule) no longer ship in this version; rows are unchanged vs the audited e7441e1f and every reference reproduced to the last digit after the rebuild. The FTS/HPC API exposes no historical vintages (checked), so training-label timing and full-row historical availability are unverified and none is claimed: this is current-vintage retrospective research under a restricted isolated-rows protocol, never a certified historical-forecasting setup. Measured finding carried beside every figure: on the identical 139 eval rows the stock runner scores 0.6452 while the persistence reference (persistence_last_coverage, recomputed scorer-side from prior-in-time labels because its feature form is exactly the removed P0 channel) scores 0.7171136653895275 - the model trails persistence by 0.0719 and every other measured simple reference except the majority-class rate: no demonstrated headroom under this protocol for the stock runner. The comparison carries an inherent information asymmetry that must travel with the number: the model is deliberately denied the last prior same-country outcome under the operator's P0 standard while the persistence reference reads it scorer-side (train+eval labels only; the holdout is never opened). Any headroom claim requires beating persistence_last_coverage on the same rows.
